newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM preferred shares set at 4.68 pesos.
newsitem.headline: RFM preferred shares set at 4.68 pesos.

text.p: Food and beverage conglomerate RFM Corp said on Tuesday it would sell convertible preferred shares at 4.68 pesos per share.
RFM said in a statement it will sell 254.466 million preferred shares to shareholders at a ratio of one share for every five and a half RFM common shares held.
The sale, scheduled between February 24 and March 14, is expected to generate 1.2 billion pesos in fresh equity.

RFM Corp chairman Jose Concepcion III said 10 percent of the float proceeds will be invested in ongoing expansion of the company's beverage, branded food, and retail food franchising businesses and property development.
The preferred shares will have a fixed dividend rate of 10 percent per annum, payable quarterly. They will be convertible into one common share each 180 days after the issue date.
